## Your market research command center

Build sophisticated, multi-layered market analyses on an interactive canvas. Drag intelligence components, connect insights, and let AI do the heavy lifting — from SWOT and Porter's Five Forces to competitor deep-dives and pricing signals.

### Drag & Drop Intelligence

Add competitor analysis, market overviews, PESTLE scans, pricing signals, and 20+ strategic components to your canvas — each powered by live AI research.

### Strategic Frameworks Built In

Run SWOT, Porter's Five Forces, pain point analysis, and positioning gap assessments — all auto-generated from real web data and AI synthesis.

### Auto-Generated Reports

Every canvas component feeds into a structured, color-coded report with table of contents, source citations, and full version history — editable and exportable.

### Deep Web Research

Each intelligence node runs real-time web searches across news, filings, social data, and industry databases — then synthesizes findings with GPT-4o.

### Visual Collaboration Tools

Annotate with shapes, sticky notes, text boxes, and emojis. Group findings visually, add context, and build a canvas your whole team can understand.

### AI Chat Assistant

Ask questions, trigger new analyses, and refine your report — all from an integrated chat that understands your entire workspace context.

## How it works

From question to decision-ready brief in three steps.

1

### Enter a market or competitor

Type a company name, ticker symbol, or market question. Our AI understands context.

2

### We gather live signals from 250+ sources

SEC filings, Google Trends, social platforms, news, patents, job postings — aggregated in real time.

3

### You get a structured brief with actions

Opportunities, threats, and recommended next steps — exportable to PDF, CSV, or PPTX.

## Everything you get

Workspaces, intelligence tools, monitoring, and system integrations — explore each capability below.

### Workspaces

5 capabilities

Your strategic research command center

Each workspace focuses on a specific market, company, or decision — combining a visual canvas, AI chat, structured reports, and decision tracking in one place.

#### Visual Canvas

Drag & drop intelligence nodes onto an interactive board — competitor analysis, market reports, SWOT, and more.

#### AI Assistant

Ask questions about your workspace data and get grounded answers with source citations.

#### Workspace Reports

AI synthesizes all canvas nodes into a single structured executive brief with cross-referenced findings.

#### Decision Tracking

Record decisions, link supporting evidence, and track outcomes over time.

#### Sharing & Collaboration

Generate share links with optional password protection — viewers don't need a MarketGeist account.

### Intelligence Tools

8 report types + 8 tools

On-demand AI research for every question

Deep web research across 250+ sources, powered by advanced AI models with 25,000+ token outputs and inline source citations. Use standalone or combine in workspaces.

#### Decision Brief

Quick go/no-go market assessment with top players, opportunities, threats, and actions.

#### Market Guide

Comprehensive market overview with segments, maturity, and vendor landscape.

#### Buyer's Guide

Evaluation framework with vendor comparison matrix and TCO analysis.

#### TAM / SAM / SOM

Market sizing with methodology, growth projections, and addressable segments.

#### Trend Report

Emerging trends with adoption curves, impact assessment, and early signals.

#### Vendor Evaluation

Detailed vendor scoring with strengths, weaknesses, and fit analysis.

#### Competitive Benchmark

Side-by-side player comparison on key performance dimensions.

#### Forecast / Outlook

Forward-looking projections with bull/base/bear scenarios.

#### Competitor Tracking

Monitor competitor websites every 6 hours — pricing changes, product launches, messaging shifts.

#### Stock Intelligence

Financial scans of public companies — stock performance, earnings, analyst ratings, insider activity.

#### SEO & Keywords

Website audits, keyword research with opportunity scoring, and ongoing ranking tracking.

#### News Intelligence

AI-categorized news from 500+ sources — filtered by company, industry, event type, and geography.

#### Sales Plays

Trigger-based selling strategies with talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive positioning.

#### Social Trends

Trending topics from Reddit, X, TikTok, and Google Trends with sentiment analysis.

#### Annual Reports

AI analysis of 10-K filings — extracting strategy, risks, revenue breakdown, and forward guidance.

#### AI Chat

Conversational AI grounded in your research data — ask follow-ups and test hypotheses.

### Monitoring

5 tools

Always-on market surveillance

Continuous background monitoring that watches for competitor moves, market signals, and emerging patterns — so you never miss a critical development.

#### Alerts

Rule-based notifications for competitor changes, pricing moves, product launches, and keyword mentions.

#### Signals

AI-curated intelligence events — patterns and trends you didn't know to look for.

#### Market Pulse

Real-time health dashboard showing momentum across news, social, search, funding, and hiring.

#### Watchlists

Curated lists of companies, keywords, and topics that feed into Alerts and Signals.

#### Intelligence Graph

Visual network showing connections between companies, markets, technologies, and trends.

### System & API

3 tools

Connect, extend, and automate

Plug MarketGeist into your existing workflow — Slack notifications, webhook automations, programmatic API access, and a browsable market data library.

#### Integrations

Slack alerts, webhook payloads, and email digests — intelligence delivered where your team already works.

#### Market Data

Browse thousands of company profiles and industry summaries powering the intelligence engine.

#### API Keys

Programmatic REST API access with scoped keys — embed intelligence in your own apps and workflows.
